description: List Capacitor plugins: the official plugins maintained by the Capacitor team and community plugins from the awesome-capacitorjs list maintained by Capawesome. Use this to find a plugin for a native capability before writing custom native code, and to learn which package name and maintainer a capability belongs to. Returns `name`, `description`, `source`, `maintainer` and `url` per plugin, plus `core: true` for a plugin that ships with @capacitor/core and `experimental: true` for an experimental one. Results are ranked by relevance, with official Capacitor plugins ranked first, then plugins maintained by Capawesome, then other community plugins. Do not use this to read a plugin's API: call `get_doc_page` with the `url` of an official plugin, and use the Capawesome MCP server at https://mcp.capawesome.io/mcp for Capawesome plugins.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return, e.g. 5. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

query.description: A free-text filter matching the package name or the description, e.g. "camera". Defaults to no filter. Optional.

source.description: Which plugins to list: "official" for the plugins maintained by the Capacitor team, "community" for the awesome-capacitorjs entries, or "all" for both. Defaults to "all".

name: list_plugins
title: List Capacitor plugins
